lines.en: label resetsix3:
scene ayaneandthetent1
: I’ve been waiting.
lines.zh: : 我一直在等。

lines.en: : You look like you’ve just seen a ghost.
lines.zh: : 你看起来像是刚见了鬼。

lines.en: : I’m in no mood for jokes right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在没心情开玩笑。

lines.en: : I can see that. I wasn’t trying to make a joke, though.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。不过我本来也没打算开玩笑。

lines.en: : Is it really {i}you?{/i} Are you really here?
lines.zh: : 真的是{i}你{/i}吗？你真的在这儿吗？

lines.en: : I think so? I can’t really remember {i}getting{/i} here, but that’s become par for the course for situations like this.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧？我不太记得自己是{i}怎么{/i}到这儿来的，不过这种状况对我来说早就是家常便饭了。

lines.en: : What’s the last thing you remember?
lines.zh: : 你记得的最后一件事是什么？

lines.en: : I think-
lines.zh: : 我想——

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke32
scene ayaneandthetent1
: Talking to Maya...outside of the karaoke booth. Was that where it started this time? Did we {i}all{/i} black out?
lines.zh: : 跟 Maya 说话……在卡拉OK包厢外面。这次是从那儿开始的吗？我们{i}全都{/i}断片了吗？

lines.en: : Yes and no...I don’t remember leaving, but I {i}do{/i} remember you acting strange before everything went to Hell.
lines.zh: : 是，也不是……我不记得自己是怎么离开的，但我{i}确实{/i}记得，在一切都坠入地狱之前，你表现得不太对劲。

lines.en: : Well, what else happened while I was out? Have you found Maya yet?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不在的时候还发生了什么？你找到 Maya 了吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent2
: No...I haven’t. And I’m really not in any rush to tell you what happened after you came back into the room.
lines.zh: : 没有……还没。而且我真的不太想告诉你，你回到房间之后发生了什么。

lines.en: : That sounds...ominous.
lines.zh: : 听起来……不妙。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent3
: It was way worse than just {i}ominous.{/i} It was terrifying. And even after all this time, I still can’t get it out of my-
lines.zh: : 那可远远不止是{i}不妙{/i}。那是恐怖。而且过了这么久，我还是没办法把它从我的——

lines.en: : Wait, {i}all this time?{/i} How long have I been gone?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}这么久{/i}？我消失了多久？

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent4
: It’ll be thirty-five days since I woke up tomorrow. I think. I’ve been trying to keep track, but the clocks are acting...kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 到明天，我醒过来就满三十五天了。我想是的。我一直在努力记着，可时钟走得……有点怪。

lines.en: : What?...
: I’ve been waiting all this time...
lines.zh: : 我等了整整这么久……

lines.en: : It’s been thirty-five days and Maya isn’t here yet? The world hasn’t reset yet?
lines.zh: : 都三十五天了，Maya 还没来？世界还没重置？

lines.en: : No, but...Sensei...I don’t think this is like the other times we’ve done this.
lines.zh: : 没有，可是……Sensei……我觉得这一次跟我们以前经历的不一样。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can tell by my month-long absence.
lines.zh: : 嗯，光看我消失一个月就知道了。

lines.en: : That’s not what I mean. Even the way it started...it was nothing like the other times I’ve done this. And I want to think it was all just a...mirage, but...
lines.zh: : 我不是这个意思。就连它开始的方式……也跟我以前经历的完全不同。我也想安慰自己说那只不过是一场……幻影，可是……

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent5
: My clothes...when I woke up...
lines.zh: : 我的衣服……我醒来的时候……

lines.en: : They were still...They were covered in...in...
lines.zh: : 上面还……上面沾满了……沾满了……

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent6
: Sensei, I’ve got a really bad feeling about all this.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我对这一切有种非常糟糕的预感。

lines.en: : We need to find Maya.
lines.zh: : 我们得找到 Maya。

lines.en: : We {i}can’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们{i}做不到{/i}。

lines.en: : What do you mean we can’t? We’ve done it before. We just have to-
lines.zh: : 什么叫做不到？我们以前做到过。我们只需要——

lines.en: : I mean we literally can’t leave. Everything outside of the school is gone. All we can do is wait for Maya to show up {i}here.{/i} There’s no way we can go out and look for her.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我们根本出不去。学校外面的一切都没了。我们唯一能做的，就是等 Maya 出现在{i}这里{/i}。我们不可能出去找她。

lines.en: : What do you mean everything is gone? That doesn’t make sense.
lines.zh: : 什么叫一切都没了？这说不通。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent7
: Yeah! I know that! {i}Nothing{/i} makes sense! And things {i}already{/i} didn’t make sense before! But now they somehow make even {i}less{/i} sense! I don’t know what else you want me to tell you!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！我知道！{i}没有一件事{/i}说得通！而且在这之前{i}本来{/i}就都说不通！可现在它们不知怎么变得更{i}说不通{/i}了！我不知道你还想让我说什么！

lines.en: : How about Makoto? Did she make it? Or...how about Sana? Is {i}she{/i} here?
lines.zh: : 那 Makoto 呢？她撑过来了吗？或者……Sana 呢？{i}她{/i}在这儿吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent8
: {i}Sana?{/i} Why would Sana be here?
lines.zh: : {i}Sana？{/i}Sana 为什么会在这儿？

lines.en: : Because she-
lines.zh: : 因为她——

lines.en: scene escapetheroom40
scene ayaneandthetent8
: Because I-
lines.zh: : 因为我——

lines.en: : I’m not...really sure...
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定……

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent9
: No one’s here but me and you...and I’m sorry to say this when I promised to be more optimistic, but I’m not feeling very hopeful that anyone else will be showing up any time soon.
lines.zh: : 这儿只有我和你……虽然我答应过要更乐观一点，可我还是很抱歉地告诉你，我不太指望短期内会有别人出现。

lines.en: : Maya will be here. She’s always here. She’s the one who-
lines.zh: : Maya 会来的。她一直在。她才是那个——

lines.en: : I told you, Sensei. Things are different this time. This isn’t what we’re used to.
lines.zh: : 我说了，Sensei。这次不一样。这不是我们习惯的那种情况。

lines.en: : Just think about it. Maya didn’t even realize this was coming. She {i}always{/i} knows when this is coming, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 你想想看。Maya 甚至都没察觉到这件事要来了。她{i}一向{/i}都能预感到它要来，不是吗？

lines.en: : Maybe that...weird feeling {i}we{/i} had was what {i}she{/i} normally feels when a reset is approaching? And we just didn’t realize it because it’s never happened to us before.
lines.zh: : 也许我们{i}我们{/i}当时那种奇怪的感觉，就是{i}她{/i}在重置临近时通常会有的感觉？只是以前从没发生在我们身上，所以我们没认出来。

lines.en: : No way...There’s no way she’d be able to keep her cool if she was going through something even remotely similar to-
lines.zh: : 不可能……她要是经历了哪怕一丁点类似的事，都不可能这么镇定——

lines.en: : Something I’ve learned this apocalypse is that Maya can “keep her cool” no matter {i}what{/i} happens. And I’d be lying if I said that didn’t terrify me.
lines.zh: : 这次末日让我学到的一件事是，Maya 无论发生{i}什么{/i}都能“保持镇定”。如果说这没把我吓到，那我是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Why would-
lines.zh: : 为什么——

lines.en: : If you saw what I saw, you’d understand.
lines.zh: : 你要是看到了我看到的东西，你就会明白。

lines.en: : But I’m glad you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 不过我很庆幸你没看到。

lines.en: : Because I don’t think you’d ever be able to forget it.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得，你要是看到了，这辈子都忘不掉。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane grabs me by the hand and pulls me out into the hallway, where the blinding blue glow of a disappearing world begins to swallow me whole.
lines.zh: Ayane 一把抓住我的手，把我拽到走廊上，那片正在消失的世界发出的刺目蓝光开始将我整个吞没。

lines.en: Maya will be here. I know she will.
lines.zh: Maya 会来的。我知道她会。

lines.en: And I’m not just saying that because I love her — I’m saying it because that is what {i}needs{/i} to happen in order for all of this to play out the way it’s supposed to.
lines.zh: 而我这么说，不是因为我爱她——而是因为那是{i}必须{/i}发生的事，好让这一切按照它应有的方式走下去。

lines.en: Her presence has been the only constant I’ve had throughout these many horrifying trips back to the beginning of our timeline.
lines.zh: 在我一次次可怕地回到时间线起点的旅程里，她的存在是我唯一不变的东西。

lines.en: And in a world that’s always repeating itself, I know she’s bound to as well.
lines.zh: 而在一个不断重复的世界里，我知道她也一定会重复出现。

lines.en: So even if Ayane is right and everything {i}is{/i} different this time, it won’t be different enough.
lines.zh: 所以，就算 Ayane 是对的、这次{i}真的{/i}什么都不一样，也不会不一样到哪儿去。

lines.en: I need to remain hopeful when no one else is.
lines.zh: 在所有人都不抱希望的时候，我必须保持希望。

lines.en: And I need to ignore the voices in the back of my mind that refuse to release their grip on it.
lines.zh: 而我也必须无视脑后那些死死揪住它不放的声音。

lines.en: Because I may not have been able to take something that doesn’t belong to me, but I’ll be damned if I don’t take {i}back{/i} something that should have been mine from the start.
lines.zh: 因为，也许我没能拿走那个不属于我的东西，但如果要我不把{i}本就{/i}该属于我的东西拿回来，那我死也不甘心。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent10
: Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : I already told you, it isn’t possible to leave.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，出不去。

lines.en: : Okay. Sure. But do you really need to squeeze my hand this hard?
lines.zh: : 好吧。当然。可你非得把我的手攥这么紧吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent11
: Fuck yes I have to squeeze your hand this hard! You really think I’m going to risk losing sight of you after worrying sick for over a month?! Not a chance!
lines.zh: : 我他妈的非得攥这么紧不可！你真以为我提心吊胆了一个多月之后，还会冒看不见你的险吗？！想都别想！

lines.en: : You’ll be lucky if I even let you go to the bathroom alone before the world resets.
lines.zh: : 在世界重置之前，我能让你一个人去上厕所就已经算你走运了。

lines.en: : You have nothing to worry about. It’s not going to reset without Maya.
lines.zh: : 你没什么好担心的。没有 Maya，它是不会重置的。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent12
: I wonder if you’d still be saying that if you were the one waiting up there instead of me...
lines.zh: : 我倒想知道，如果在上面等的人是你而不是我，你还会不会说这种话……

lines.en: : Of course I would. I’m more experienced than you when it comes to this stuff.
lines.zh: : 我当然会。这种事我比你有经验。

lines.en: : Not by a lot.
lines.zh: : 也没多多少。

lines.en: : But enough to make you at least {i}consider{/i} that I can kind of...help in some way, right?
lines.zh: : 但足够让你至少{i}考虑一下{/i}，我多少能帮上点忙，对吧？

lines.en: : Help with {i}what?{/i} All we can do is wait. No amount of planning or {i}thinking{/i} is going to help get us out of a mess that defies all logic and science.
lines.zh: : 帮{i}什么{/i}？我们只能等。再多的计划、再多的{i}思考{/i}，也帮不了我们摆脱一个完全违背逻辑和科学的烂摊子。

lines.en: : Some problems just have to fix themselves or...stay broken forever.
lines.zh: : 有些问题只能自己修复，或者……永远坏着。

lines.en: : There has to be {i}something{/i} we can do. I don’t want to risk Maya being stuck “asleep” again. Especially when you couldn’t even see her after the last time she disappeared.
lines.zh: : 总得有{i}什么{/i}我们能做的吧。我不想再冒让 Maya“睡着”的风险了。尤其是上一次她消失之后，你连看都看不见她。

lines.en: : Then maybe we’ll get lucky and you’ll see her up there and we’ll all live happily ever after.
lines.zh: : 那也许我们会走运，你能在上面看见她，然后我们就从此幸福地生活在一起了。

lines.en: : Ayane, I get that it’s probably hard to be optimistic when you’ve been stuck here for over a month...but if you start losing it now, I will too. And we don’t have any time to waste on...mental instability.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我知道你被困在这儿一个多月，大概很难乐观起来……可你要是现在就开始崩溃，我也会跟着崩溃。而我们没有时间浪费在……精神不稳定上。

lines.en: : Well, let’s see if you can figure out a way to remain “mentally stable” once you see what I’ve been looking at for thirty-five days...
lines.zh: : 那好，等你看看我这三十五天里一直盯着的东西，再看看你还怎么保持“精神稳定”吧……

lines.en: scene black
scene ayaneandthetent13
: I’m not really sure what I’m looking at right now.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定自己现在在看什么。

lines.en: : It wraps around the entire building.
lines.zh: : 它环绕着整栋楼。

lines.en: : I felt like it was closing in at first, but I’m pretty sure that was just me having a perpetual panic attack.
lines.zh: : 一开始我觉得它在往里收缩，不过我敢说那只是因为我一直在无休止地恐慌发作。

lines.en: : Have you tried going through it?
lines.zh: : 你试过穿过去吗？

lines.en: : I tried poking it since you can reach it from the front steps of the school, but doing that just sent me back up here.
lines.zh: : 我试过戳它——从学校正门的台阶那儿够得着——可一戳它就把我弹回这上面来了。

lines.en: : The pictures change every few hours, but I don’t think it’s, like...a puzzle or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 画面每隔几个小时就会变，不过我觉得它不像……谜题之类的东西。

lines.en: : I’ve been keeping track of them in a notebook to see if I can figure out if they {i}mean{/i} anything, but I think it’s just the world being broken again.
lines.zh: : 我一直在笔记本上记录它们，想看看它们{i}到底{/i}有没有什么含义，可我觉得那只是世界又坏了而已。

lines.en: : This is why I said you can’t leave. It’s not like the last few times where the sky gets all cool-looking and the rest of the city stays mostly the same.
lines.zh: : 这就是我说的你出不去的理由。不像前几次，天空变得很酷炫，城里的其他地方大体还保持原样。

lines.en: : This time, it’s like the city doesn’t even exist. And that the world’s been whittled down to just the school.
lines.zh: : 这一次，城市简直像是不存在了。整个世界被削减成了只剩这所学校。

lines.en: : She’ll be here, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 她会来的，Ayane。

lines.en: : If you say so, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你说是就是吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : Do you want coffee or something? We’re probably going to be here for a while.
lines.zh: : 要不要来点咖啡什么的？我们大概得在这儿待上一阵子。

lines.en: : Sure. If you’re running to Koi Cafe, I’ll take a Copyrighted Frozen Beverage.
lines.zh: : 好啊。要是你去 Koi Cafe 的话，我要一杯“版权冷冻饮品”。

lines.en: : Lucky for you, I’ve set up my {i}own{/i} Koi Cafe.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我开了{i}自己{/i}的 Koi Cafe。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane lets go of my arm for the first time since I opened my eyes or...regained consciousness or...whatever it is that happens when I snap out of reset-induced delusions.
lines.zh: Ayane 从我睁开眼——或者说恢复意识——或者说不管我从重置引发的幻觉里回过神来时叫什么——以来，第一次松开了我的胳膊。

lines.en: It’s a little strange, though.
lines.zh: 不过这有点奇怪。

lines.en: I feel like...I remember most of this one.
lines.zh: 我觉得……这一次我大部分都记得。

lines.en: I remember being locked in a house.
lines.zh: 我记得自己被锁在一栋房子里。

lines.en: I remember...being alone.
lines.zh: 我记得……独自一人。

lines.en: Delicious hot pot.
lines.zh: 美味的火锅。

lines.en: A girl who grew up.
lines.zh: 一个长大了的小姑娘。

lines.en: scene papercity31
scene papercity32
scene papercity33
scene papercity34
scene papercity35
scene ayaneandthetent14
And...
lines.zh: 还有……

lines.en: And that’s it.
lines.zh: 还有，就这么多了。

lines.en: Nothing else happened.
lines.zh: 别的什么都没发生。

lines.en: : You’ve...made quite a home for yourself up here, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……在上面给自己搭了个相当像样的家啊，是不是？

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent15
: It’s not like I had anything else going on. And you’d be surprised what you can find lying around the school.
lines.zh: : 反正我也没有别的事可做。而且你会惊讶于学校里随手能捡到些什么。

lines.en: : You’ve got electricity and everything.
lines.zh: : 你连电都通了。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent16
: I do! And might I add that I’m extremely proud of myself for being able to lug {i}multiple{/i} generators up three flights of stairs. Even {i}if{/i} it did take an entire day.
lines.zh: : 那当然！而且我要补充一句，我能把{i}好几台{/i}发电机扛上三层楼，我对自己骄傲极了。{i}虽然{/i}这花了我整整一天。

lines.en: : Well, at least you haven’t been sitting here doing nothing. I feel less bad about making you wait a month now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少你没坐在这儿干等着。让你等了一个月，我心里也好受些了。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent17
: You should still feel very bad about that and you should never do it again. Because even if I have food and water, the library’s DVD selection is {i}extremely{/i} lacking.
lines.zh: : 你还是该为此感到非常内疚，而且绝不能再有下一次。因为就算我有食物有水，图书馆的 DVD 收藏也{i}实在{/i}太寒酸了。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many times I’ve watched the Breakfast Club now? Because it is a number I am not proud of, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你知道《早餐俱乐部》我已经看了多少遍了吗？那个数字说出来我自己都不好意思，Sensei。

lines.en: : My English has gotten better, though. So at least there’s that.
lines.zh: : 不过我的英语变好了。至少这点还算收获。

lines.en: : Leave it to the almost-eternal optimist to find a silver lining in the picture-clouds of the apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 也就只有你这个近乎永恒的乐观主义者，才能在末日的画面云里找到一线希望。

lines.en: : It helps being a little insane too. I can’t imagine many people in my situation would have set up a base camp, but here I am.
lines.zh: : 稍微有点疯也有帮助。我想没多少人处在我这种境地还能搭起个营地，可我就搭了。

lines.en: : Your mild insanity is the only thing keeping me grounded right now, so thanks for that.
lines.zh: : 你这点轻度疯狂是现在唯一能让我脚踏实地的东西，所以谢了。

lines.en: : You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : I can only imagine what you had to go through to make it here, but I’m glad you did.
lines.zh: : 我能想象你是经历了什么才走到这儿来的，不过我很高兴你来了。

lines.en: : Like I said, though. All there is to do now is continue playing the waiting game. I hope you like the Breakfast Club.
lines.zh: : 不过就像我说的，现在能做的只有继续玩这个等待游戏。希望你喜欢《早餐俱乐部》。

lines.en: : You know...maybe I’ll take some coffee after all.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我还是来点咖啡吧。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent18
: It would be my pleasure, sir. Please take a seat inside our {i}lovely{/i} triangular housing and I’ll have our wait staff bring it out right away.
lines.zh: : 这是我的荣幸，先生。请在我们{i}温馨{/i}的三角小屋里入座，我马上让服务生给您端上来。

lines.en: : I even get to see your tent? You’re far too kind.
lines.zh: : 我还能参观你的帐篷？你真是太客气了。

lines.en: : Just wait until you see what {i}other{/i} services we provide.
lines.zh: : 等你看看我们还提供{i}哪些{/i}服务再说吧。

lines.en: : This is probably the least appropriate it has ever been for you to hit on me.
lines.zh: : 这大概是有史以来最不适合你撩我的时刻了。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent19
: It’s been thirty-five days. {i}Excuse me{/i} for getting a little excited.
lines.zh: : 都三十五天了。{i}抱歉{/i}我稍微激动了一下。

lines.en: : Now, go sit down so I can continue acting like your wife-slash-barista.
lines.zh: : 好了，去坐下吧，我好继续扮演你的妻子兼咖啡师。

lines.en: scene black
I climb into the tent and find there’s not much inside apart from a futon, a lamp, and a few notebooks Ayane’s been writing in.
lines.zh: 我爬进帐篷，发现里面没什么东西，只有一床被褥、一盏灯，还有几本 Ayane 一直在写的笔记本。

lines.en: It smells like her. Though, I guess that’s not surprising since she’s essentially been living here for over a month.
lines.zh: 帐篷里有她的味道。不过想想也不奇怪，她基本上已经在这儿住了一个多月。

lines.en: It’s comforting in a way that nothing ever is anymore. {i}Especially{/i} nothing on this rooftop.
lines.zh: 这有种让人安心的感觉，是这世上任何东西都不再能给我的。{i}尤其是{/i}这屋顶上的任何东西。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent20
But even if that indiscernible flowery scent of perfume that she {i}still{/i} wears despite what could have been indefinite loneliness clings to my nostrils, my heart can’t help but wander elsewhere.
lines.zh: 可就算她那股说不清的花香香水味——{i}即便{/i}面对可能是无尽的孤独，她{i}依然{/i}擦着它——萦绕在我的鼻端，我的心还是忍不住飘向别处。

lines.en: Even now, in this claustrophobic polyester pyramid where the two of us are as close as we can be without staining the sheets, I’m thinking of someone else.
lines.zh: 即便是现在，在这间幽闭的聚酯纤维金字塔里，我们两个已经近到不能再近、只差没弄脏床单，我心里想的还是别人。

lines.en: I’m {i}worried{/i} about someone else.
lines.zh: 我在{i}担心{/i}别人。

lines.en: And she knows it.
lines.zh: 而她知道。

lines.en: I {i}know{/i} she knows it.
lines.zh: 我{i}知道{/i}她知道。

lines.en: I can tell from the pheromones that have abandoned her body and flooded the tent. They dance in circles around the two pillows she dragged in here, yet she abstains from touching me because she {i}cares.{/i}
lines.zh: 我看得出来——那些信息素已经离开了她的身体，涌满了整个帐篷。它们绕着她拖进来的两个枕头打转，可她克制着不来碰我，因为她{i}在乎{/i}。

lines.en: And she doesn’t want to force something out of me when all I’ve ever done is force things out of her.
lines.zh: 而且她不想逼我说出什么，毕竟我一直以来都在逼她。

lines.en: I’m sure she wouldn’t describe it that way if you asked her where her mind was. I’m sure she’d mention something about how easy it is to read me when I’ve always been her favorite book.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，你要是问她脑子里在想什么，她不会这么描述。我敢肯定她会说，读我太容易了，因为我一直是她最爱的那本书。

lines.en: But if you ask me why she’s fascinated with martyrdom in a world without anyone to die for, I’d tell you it’s because she’s special.
lines.zh: 可你要是问我，为什么在一个没人值得她赴死的世界里，她还这么迷恋殉道——我会告诉你，那是因为她很特别。

lines.en: That she’s a little insane.
lines.zh: 因为她有点疯。

lines.en: And that there really isn’t anyone who would handle this the way she does.
lines.zh: 而且真的没有别人能像她这样应对这一切。

lines.en: : Can I ask you something, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我能问你个事吗？

lines.en: : Sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 当然。怎么了？

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, if the world never resets and the two of us are stuck here for the rest of eternity, how long do you want to wait before we start repopulating the planet?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇——如果世界永远不重置，我们两个要在这儿被困到永远，你想等多久再开始重新繁衍人类？

lines.en: : Not the direction I expected this to go in.
lines.zh: : 我没想到话题会往这个方向走。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent21
: I think that’s a perfectly reasonable question! It’s our duty as Japanese citizens to procreate. Even when the rest of the world disappears.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是个完全合理的问题！繁衍后代是我们作为日本公民的义务。哪怕世界其他部分都消失了也一样。

lines.en: : Your mind is everywhere but where it’s meant to be right now, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你的心思现在飘得到处都是，就是没在该在的地方，是吧？

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent20
: Where would you say it’s meant to be?
lines.zh: : 那你说它该在哪儿？

lines.en: : A way out....what we’re supposed to do next...anywhere but mindless fun and what-if scenarios.
lines.zh: : 出路……我们下一步该怎么办……除了没脑子的玩乐和假设之外，哪儿都行。

lines.en: : Doing that would drive me even {i}more{/i} insane. Besides, I’ve more than paid my dues when it comes to critical thinking over the last month.
lines.zh: : 想那些只会让我变得{i}更{/i}疯。再说了，上个月我已经把批判性思考的份儿都还完了。

lines.en: : Now that you’re here and we can be together again, I kind of just want to...go back to normal for a little while. Because who knows if we’ll ever be able to do that again?
lines.zh: : 现在你在这儿，我们又可以在一起了，我只想……稍微回到正常一点。因为谁知道我们以后还能不能再这样？

lines.en: : You look upset. How come?
lines.zh: : 你看起来不太高兴。怎么了？

lines.en: : Ayane, when you were...feeling “weird” the day of the Halloween party...were you, like...{i}hearing{/i} things?
lines.zh: : Ayane，万圣节派对那天你“感觉不对劲”的时候……你有没有，比方说……{i}听见{/i}什么？

lines.en: : You mean like voices?
lines.zh: : 你是说像声音那样？

lines.en: : Exactly. Does that mean you were?
lines.zh: : 对。这么说你有？

lines.en: : Were {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}有吗？

lines.en: : I asked you first.
lines.zh: : 是我先问你的。

lines.en: : And I made you coffee.
lines.zh: : 而我给你煮了咖啡。

lines.en: : Then...yeah. I was.
lines.zh: : 那……好吧。我有。

lines.en: : Haven’t you always, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你不一直都听得到吗？

lines.en: : I know you’ve had {i}stuff{/i} like that going on forever. And I know that’s why your bond with...Ami has...gotten so strong.
lines.zh: : 我知道你{i}这种{/i}状况从很久以前就有了。我也知道，正因为如此，你和……Ami 之间的羁绊才会变得这么深。

lines.en: : Not like this. This time was different.
lines.zh: : 不是这样的。这次不一样。

lines.en: : I’m not surprised. Everything {i}about{/i} this time is different. And, apart from being able to hang out in a tent with you, none of it’s really good.
lines.zh: : 我并不意外。这次{i}一切{/i}都不一样。而且除了能跟你一起窝在帐篷里，没一样是好的。

lines.en: : Were they saying anything specific?
lines.zh: : 它们有说具体的内容吗？

lines.en: : You don’t have to tell me if you don’t want to. I get it.
lines.zh: : 你不想说就不用说。我理解的。

lines.en: : It’s less that I don’t want to and more like I...feel like I’m not {i}supposed{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 与其说我不想说，不如说我觉得自己{i}不该{/i}说。

lines.en: : All rules get thrown out the window when the world is ending, Sensei. You can say or do anything you want here.
lines.zh: : 世界末日的时候，所有规则都被扔出窗外了，Sensei。在这里你想说什么、做什么都可以。

lines.en: : I think this might be my last reset.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这可能是我最后一次重置了。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent22
: ...what?
: I keep...hearing this message that...if I don’t “take something that doesn’t belong to me,” something will be taken from {i}me{/i} instead.
lines.zh: : 我一直……听到这样一段讯息……如果我不“拿走那个不属于我的东西”，就会有东西从我{i}身上{/i}被拿走。

lines.en: : What does...that mean?
lines.zh: : 那……是什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m not sure, but...I have an idea. The point is, though, time is up.
lines.zh: : 我不确定，不过……我有个想法。关键是，时间到了。

lines.en: : I had until the end of summer and, if you hadn’t already noticed, I think that time has come.
lines.zh: : 我本来可以撑到夏天结束，而如果你还没注意到的话，我觉得那一天已经到了。

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. So, it’s...just because of that voice thing that you think you’re not going to make it through this reset? How did you come to that conclusion?
lines.zh: : 等等，你先别急。所以……就因为那个声音，你就觉得自己撑不过这次重置？你是怎么得出这个结论的？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t call it a {i}conclusion.{/i} It’s more like a feeling. Like I was put here for some sort of purpose and, if I’m not going to fulfill it, there’s no reason for me to exist at all.
lines.zh: : 我不会把它叫做{i}结论{/i}。更像是一种感觉。就好像我被放到这里是有某种目的的，而如果我不去完成它，我就没有存在的理由了。

lines.en: : Why do you need to have a purpose? Why can’t you just...be you?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非得有个目的？为什么不能就……做你自己？

lines.en: : I wish I had an answer to that.
lines.zh: : 我也希望我有个答案。

lines.en: : No...you don’t. Because you don’t {i}need{/i} to have an answer to that.
lines.zh: : 不……你不需要。因为你{i}不需要{/i}对那个问题有答案。

lines.en: : Who cares if you’re not fulfilling your {i}purpose?{/i} Just live happily and let everything else fall into place after that.
lines.zh: : 谁在乎你有没有完成你的{i}目的{/i}？快快乐乐地活着，剩下的事自然会各就各位。

lines.en: : But the voice-
lines.zh: : 可是那个声音——

lines.en: : You think you’re the only person to hear a voice like that? One that tells you you’re not good enough and that you need to be someone else? {i}Everyone{/i} hears that.
lines.zh: : 你以为只有你一个人听到那种声音吗？那种告诉你“你还不够好、你得变成另一个人”的声音？{i}每个人{/i}都听得到。

lines.en: : I...okay. Sure. But I feel like the way this one is being {i}delivered{/i} to me is a little different than the idea of everyone feeling subconsciously incomplete.
lines.zh: : 我……好吧。当然。可我觉得它对我{i}传达{/i}的方式，跟那种“大家潜意识里都觉得不完整”的说法不太一样。

lines.en: : That’s not what I-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个——

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent23
: Hah...
scene ayaneandthetent24
: Okay. Yeah. I may have...inadvertently sounded a little preachy and generic just now. And I get that that doesn’t compare to what you are personally going through.
lines.zh: : 好吧。是的是的。我刚才……可能不小心说得像在说教、又很空泛。我也知道那比不了你亲身经历的东西。

lines.en: : But {i}I’ve{/i} been hearing things too, Sensei. {i}Actual{/i} voices. That want me to do things for them that I don’t {i}want{/i} to do. And Ami heard...hears them too.
lines.zh: : 可是{i}我{/i}也一直在听到东西，Sensei。是{i}真的{/i}声音。它们要我去做一些我{i}不{/i}想做的事。而 Ami 也听到过……现在也听得到。

lines.en: : What? Then...why haven’t you ever said anything?
lines.zh: : 什么？那……你为什么从来没说过？

lines.en: : Uhh...because it’s creepy and totally fake?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为那很诡异，而且完全是假的？

lines.en: : I just ignore them and nothing bad ever happens to me. Well, apart from being sucked into the apocalypse and being forced to watch the Breakfast Club over and over.
lines.zh: : 我就是不理它们，然后从来也没出过什么坏事。除了被卷进末日、被迫一遍又一遍地看《早餐俱乐部》之外。

lines.en: : You’re getting scared for no reason. And you’re scaring {i}me{/i} by saying things like “This might be my last reset” when that’s completely untrue.
lines.zh: : 你在毫无理由地害怕。而你说什么“这可能是我最后一次重置”这种完全不实的话，是在吓{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s never over until it’s over. And you’re better than giving up just because the angel on your shoulder hates you even more than {i}you{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 只要还没结束，就永远不算结束。而且你不至于因为肩膀上那个天使比你{i}自己{/i}还讨厌你，就放弃了吧。

lines.en: : You’re gonna be okay. We’ll get through this together.
lines.zh: : 你会没事的。我们会一起熬过去的。

lines.en: : And if we don’t?
lines.zh: : 要是熬不过去呢？

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent25
: If we don’t, then I’m definitely jumping on your replacement ASAP and having as many babies as possible.
lines.zh: : 要是熬不过去，那我肯定立马扑向你的替代品，能生多少孩子就生多少。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent26
: Oh, come on. I’m obviously kidding.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我显然是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : If we don’t, I’m sure {i}one{/i} of us will figure something out.
lines.zh: : 要是熬不过去，我相信{i}我们之间{/i}总有一个人能想出办法。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s me. Maybe it’s you. Maybe it’s Maya. Maybe it’s someone completely unexpected. And maybe it takes another thousand or...million years or whatever.
lines.zh: : 也许是我。也许是你。也许是 Maya。也许是个完全出乎意料的人。也许还得再过一千年……一百万年，什么的。

lines.en: : Predicting the future sucks because all it really does is make the present more nerve-wracking. And the present for us kind of sucks to begin with.
lines.zh: : 预测未来糟透了，因为它唯一的作用就是让当下更让人焦虑。而我们的当下本来就够糟了。

lines.en: : So just...worry about today. Then, when you wake up in the morning, you can worry about tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 所以就……只操心今天吧。等你早上醒来，再去操心明天。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent27
: Which, by then, would {i}also{/i} be today. But I think you get what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 到那时候，明天{i}也{/i}变成今天了。不过我想你懂我的意思。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I think I get what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 我想我懂你的意思。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent20
: Great.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Then, please excuse me while I take a much needed nap.
lines.zh: : 那么，请允许我小睡一会儿，我真的太需要了。

lines.en: scene black
: Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. You can keep talking to me. I just want to rest my head on your lap for a little while. I’ve been extremely Sensei-deprived lately and if I don’t do something about it now, I’m going to die.
lines.zh: : 别担心。你可以继续跟我说话。我只是想在你腿上枕一会儿。最近我极度缺乏 Sensei，要是不现在补回来，我会死的。

lines.en: scene ayaneandthetent28
: Are you happy now?
lines.zh: : 你现在开心了吗？

lines.en: : I missed this.
lines.zh: : 我好怀念这样。

lines.en: : I missed you too.
lines.zh: : 我也想你了。

lines.en: : No you didn’t. You were too caught up in blackout-mode to miss me.
lines.zh: : 不，你才没有。你那时候忙着断片，根本没空想我。

lines.en: : In fact, the only reason I found you in the first place was because I heard banging in one of the classrooms when I went to get some more supplies. You’re lucky I didn’t bring my gun.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我之所以能找到你，是因为我去拿补给的时候听见一间教室里有人在砰砰乱敲。你该庆幸我没带枪。

lines.en: : I think calling either of us lucky in {i}any{/i} regard can’t possibly be accurate when we have to go through things like this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，在我们不得不经历这些事的时候，说我们俩谁“幸运”都不可能准确。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} think you’re wrong. Because we’re definitely lucky to have met each other.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}觉得你错了。因为我们能遇见彼此，绝对是幸运的。

lines.en: : And we’re definitely lucky to have fallen in love.
lines.zh: : 而我们能坠入爱河，也绝对是幸运的。

lines.en: : I’m so happy you’re back.
lines.zh: : 你回来了，我太高兴了。

lines.en: scene black
: Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。
